summary: Blocked before editing: the current transport core still exposes only `Handler = Fn(WireFrame) -> Option<WireFrame>`, so the Tauri callback cannot return typed authentication/database errors or produce fresh authenticated response frames with the persistent session key and counter. The existing `serve` authenticates the request, then invokes an unsigned response callback; integrating the requested pair/session/history/queue authority would therefore either drop failures, emit unauthenticated responses, or bypass the required fail-closed semantics. No files were modified or committed.
